name: Till You Come Home
source:
"A demo for O2A2 2022.

When the head of a scientist is found on the beach, FBI agent Jerry is on the case to find out the grisly details but first he most go through files recovered from the scientist."

[From [url=https://eriksblue.itch.io/till-you-come-home]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“O2A2 2022的演示。

当一名科学家的头颅在海滩上被发现时，联邦调查局特工杰里正在调查此案，以查明可怕的细节，但他首先会查看从该科学家身上找到的文件。”

[来自[url=https://eriksblue.itch.io/till-you-come-home]itch.io[/url]]
